summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (University of Oklahoma, July 2025), with research on data-efficient and trustworthy AI for resilient wireless networks. Peer-reviewed work in cellular reliability, propagation digital twins and learning-based network optimization, complemented by smartwatch sensing and sequential activity recognition. University-level instructor of Computer Programming, Communication Systems and Wireless Communication; experience in laboratory support, student mentoring and industry research at AT&T Labs and Futurewei. Proposes an independent research program connecting AI for next-generation networks and healthcare technology through robust, measurable intelligent systems.
